# U106: A metric changes and is retired: as Rhea, Lead time for changes’ caveats save at once; its meaning reads back first, asks “Is it still the same number?”, names its goal, and with “The number itself changes” is refused without a reason; once said, the goal’s chart has the line “Definition changed, week {w}”. Flaky test rate is retired with a reason, says so on its page, and “Bring it back” restores it. As Amara, Lead time for changes merges into Time to first review (both in hours) and its goal moves. As Tunde, none of these buttons exist

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-CHANGE`
- **Budget:** at most 30 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/metrics/metric_lead-time/edit` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U106

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/metrics/metric_lead-time/edit` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Caveats” field shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) scored as met here.
- **Step.** Type “Counts only services on the paved road.” into the “Caveats” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/demo/metrics/lead-time(? / # / $)”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- _Note:_ The meaning: read back, the question, the goal named, and Why a Must fix once the number itself changes.
- Go to `/metrics/metric_lead-time/edit` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “From merge to production, the median over 30 days.” into the “What it means” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** “Is it still the same number?” is shown in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`) (else: a new meaning is not read back with the question).
- _Note:_ The read-back is a sheet: it takes the focus, and its own button is the one primary action (#351 review).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the read-back does not take the focus.
- **Check:** “1 goal is measured by it” is shown in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`) (else: the read-back does not name the goals).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “read back”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “The number itself changes” field in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`).
- **Step.** Press the “Change the meaning” button in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`).
- **Check:** “Say why, in a line. Every goal measured by it will show this.” is shown in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`) (else: the number changing is not refused without a reason).
- **Check:** (`attention`) the svg (`svg[data-status]`) in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`) is not there (else: the read-back uses a status shape).
- **Step.** Type “The DORA dashboard counts from merge now.” into the “Why” field in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`).
- **Step.** Press the “Change the meaning” button in the metric readback (`.metric-readback`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/demo/metrics/lead-time(? / # / $)”.
- _Note:_ A change offers Undo, which would take its mark back with it (#351 review).
- **Check:** (`progress`) the button in the message that pops up showing “Undo” is there (else: a metric change offers no Undo).
- Go to `/goals/ns-lead` in the demo.
- **Check:** The text in the c note (`.c-note text`) shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if the goal’s chart says “{said}”.
- _Note:_ Retire, then bring back.
- Go to `/metrics/metric_flaky-rate` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Retire this metric…” button.
- **Step.** Type “The test platform reports it now.” into the “Why” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Retire the metric” button.
- **Check:** “Retired on …: “The test platform reports it now.”” is shown in the metric retired (`.metric-retired`) (else: the retired metric’s page does not say so).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Change this metric” link is not there (else: a retired metric still offers Change this metric).
- _Note:_ It can be found again: the library links to the retired ones, which lists it (#351 review).
- Go to `/metrics` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “See the (N )?retired metrics” link.
- **Step.** Press the “Flaky test rate” link in the “Metrics” list.
- **Step.** Press the “Bring it back” button.
- **Check:** The metric retired (`.metric-retired`) goes away.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if Bring it back did not restore it.
- Close this browser.
